articles.title_en: Race and Economic Well-Being in the United States
articles.title_cn: 美国的种族与经济福祉
articles.abstract_en: We construct a measure of consumption-equivalent welfare for Black and White Americans, which incorporates life expectancy, consumption, leisure, and inequality. Based on these factors, welfare for Black Americans was 40 percent of that for White Americans in 1984 and 59 percent by 2022. There has been remarkable progress for Black Americans: The level of their consumption-equivalent welfare increased by a factor of 3.5 over the last 38 years when aggregate consumption per person only doubled. Despite this progress, the welfare gap in 2022 remains disconcertingly large at 41 percent, much larger than the 16 percent gap in consumption per person. (JEL D12, I12, I31, J15, J31, K42)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个衡量美国黑人和白人消费等价福利的指标，该指标涵盖了预期寿命、消费、休闲和 inequality。基于这些因素，1984年黑人美国人的福利为白人美国人的40%，到2022年这一比例上升至59%。黑人美国人取得了显著进步：在过去38年中，他们的消费等价福利水平增长了3.5倍，而人均总消费仅翻了一番。尽管取得了这一进步，2022年的福利差距仍高达41%，令人不安，远大于人均消费16%的差距。(JEL D12, I12, I31, J15, J31, K42)

articles.title_en: The Consumer Welfare Effects of Online Ads: Evidence from a Nine-Year Experiment
articles.title_cn: 在线广告的消费者福利效应：来自一项为期九年的实验的证据
articles.abstract_en: Research on the effects of online advertising on consumer welfare is limited due to challenges in running large-scale field experiments. We analyze a long-running field experiment on Facebook in which a random subset of users received no ads in their newsfeeds. Using an incentive-compatible deactivation experiment, we find no significant differences in users’ valuation of Facebook across a representative sample of 53,083 Facebook users in the ads and no ads groups. Our sample size allows for precise estimates, suggesting that either the disutility of ads is relatively small or that there are offsetting benefits, such as product discovery. (JEL C93, D12, D44, L82, M37)
articles.abstract_cn: 由于开展大规模现场实验的挑战，关于在线广告对消费者福利影响的研究有限。我们分析了一项在Facebook上进行的长期现场实验，其中随机选取的一部分用户在其新闻推送中未收到任何广告。通过一项激励相容的停用实验，我们发现，在代表样本中的53,083名Facebook用户中，广告组与无广告组在用户对Facebook的估值上没有显著差异。我们的样本量允许精确估计，这表明要么广告带来的负效用相对较小，要么存在抵消性的好处，如产品发现。(JEL C93, D12, D44, L82, M37)

articles.title_en: Long-Term and Lasting Impacts of Personal Initiative Training on Entrepreneurial Success
articles.title_cn: 个人主动性培训对创业成功的长期持久影响
articles.abstract_en: A randomized experiment in Togo found that personal initiative training for small businesses resulted in large and significant impacts for both men and women after two years. We revisit these entrepreneurs after seven years and find long-lasting average impacts of personal initiative training of $91-higher profits per month, which is larger than the two-year impacts. However, these long-term impacts are very different for men and women: The impact for men grows over time as they accumulate more capital and increase self-efficacy, whereas the impact for women is flat or declines, and capital buildup is much more limited. (JEL J16, J24, L25, L26, M53, O12, O14)
articles.abstract_cn: 在多哥进行的一项随机实验发现，针对小企业的个人主动性培训在两年后对男性和女性都产生了显著且重大的影响。我们在七年后重新访问这些企业家，发现个人主动性培训的长期平均影响为每月利润高出91美元，这一影响大于两年时的效果。然而，这些长期影响在男性和女性之间存在很大差异：对男性而言，影响随时间增长，因为他们积累了更多资本并增强了自我效能感；而对女性而言，影响持平或下降，资本积累也更为有限。(JEL J16, J24, L25, L26, M53, O12, O14)

articles.title_en: Sequential Sampling by Individuals and Groups: An Experimental Study
articles.title_cn: 个体与群体的序贯抽样：一项实验研究
articles.abstract_en: Many committees—juries, political task forces, etc.—spend time gathering costly information before reaching a decision. We report results from lab experiments focused on such dynamic information-collection processes, as in sequential hypothesis testing. We consider decisions governed by individuals and groups and compare how voting rules affect outcomes. Several insights emerge. First, average decision accuracies approximate those predicted theoretically, but these accuracies decline over time: Participants display nonstationary behavior. Second, groups generate markedly different outcomes than individuals, with majority rule yielding faster and less accurate decisions. In particular, welfare is higher when sequential information is collected in groups using unanimity. (JEL C83, D71, D72, D83)
articles.abstract_cn: 许多委员会——如陪审团、政治任务小组等——在做出决定之前会花费时间收集成本高昂的信息。我们报告了针对此类动态信息收集过程的实验室实验结果，如同序贯假设检验。我们考虑由个体和群体主导的决策，并比较投票规则如何影响结果。出现了几个见解。首先，平均决策准确度接近理论预测，但这些准确度随时间下降：参与者表现出非平稳行为。其次，群体产生的结果与个体显著不同，多数规则导致更快但准确性较低的决策。特别是，当群体使用一致同意规则收集序贯信息时，福利更高。(JEL C83, D71, D72, D83)

articles.title_cn: 忽视下的最优抵押贷款再融资
articles.abstract_en: We build a model of optimal fixed-rate mortgage refinancing with fixed costs and inattention and derive a new sufficient statistic that can be used to measure inattention frictions from simple moments of the rate gap distribution. In the model, borrowers pay attention to rates sporadically, so they often fail to refinance even when it is profitable. When paying attention, borrowers optimally choose to refinance earlier than under a perfect attention benchmark. Our model can rationalize almost all errors of “omission” (refinancing too slowly) and a large fraction of the errors of “commission” (refinancing too quickly) previously documented in the data. (JEL D91, G41, G51)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个包含固定成本和忽视的最优固定利率抵押贷款再融资模型，并推导出一个新的充分统计量，可用于从利率缺口分布的简单矩中衡量忽视摩擦。在该模型中，借款人偶尔关注利率，因此即使再融资有利可图，他们也常常未能进行再融资。当关注时，借款人会选择比完全关注基准下更早地进行再融资。我们的模型能够合理解释数据中先前记录的几乎所有“遗漏”错误（再融资过慢）以及大部分“错误行动”错误（再融资过快）。(JEL D91, G41, G51)

articles.title_en: Web Search Personalization during the US 2020 Election
articles.title_cn: 美国2020年选举期间的网络搜索个性化
articles.abstract_en: We study the impact of web search personalization on ideological segregation in search results. We deploy 150 synthetic internet users with randomized partisan browsing preferences across 25 US cities. These users are active during the US 2020 election and its aftermath. Daily experiments in which the users enter identical election-related queries provide strong evidence for ideological segregation in search results across locations with different partisan leanings but only limited evidence for ideological segregation within location across users with different partisan browsing habits. We discuss the important role of the national and local (online) media landscape for understanding these results. (JEL D72, D83, L82, L86)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了网络搜索个性化对搜索结果中意识形态隔离的影响。我们在美国25个城市部署了150名具有随机化党派浏览偏好的合成互联网用户。这些用户在美国2020年选举及其后续期间活跃。每日实验中，用户输入相同的选举相关查询，提供了强有力的证据表明，在不同党派倾向的地区之间，搜索结果存在意识形态隔离，但在同一地区内，不同党派浏览习惯的用户之间的意识形态隔离证据有限。我们讨论了国家和地方（在线）媒体格局在理解这些结果中的重要作用。（JEL D72, D83, L82, L86）

articles.title_en: Dynamics of Consumer Responses to Medical Price Changes
articles.title_cn: 消费者对医疗价格变化的动态反应
articles.abstract_en: How individuals respond to coinsurance rates is fundamental for insurance market design, but most existing estimates speak only to short-run responses. We exploit a unique policy experiment that increased the coinsurance rate some elderly individuals face when they are aged 70–74 but not before or after. Higher coinsurance rates have an immediate and persistent effect on health care expenditure, and a sizable share of this effect persists after age 75. We find no evidence that higher coinsurance rates affect health. These results suggest that health care utilization depends on dynamic factors other than health stock, such as habits. (JEL D12, G22, H51, I11, I12, I13, J14)
articles.abstract_cn: 个人如何应对共保率是保险市场设计的基础，但大多数现有估计仅涉及短期反应。我们利用一项独特的政策实验，该实验提高了某些老年人在年龄处于70-74岁时的共保率，但在之前或之后并未如此。较高的共保率对医疗支出有即时且持续的影响，且这一影响的相当大一部分在年龄超过75岁后仍然存在。我们没有发现较高共保率影响健康的证据。这些结果表明，医疗服务的利用取决于除健康存量之外的动态因素，如习惯。(JEL D12, G22, H51, I11, I12, I13, J14)

articles.title_en: Electric Vehicles and the Energy Transition: Unintended Consequences of Time-of-Use Pricing
articles.title_cn: 电动汽车与能源转型：分时定价的意外后果
articles.abstract_en: The growth of electric vehicles (EVs) raises new challenges for electricity systems. We implement a field experiment to assess the effect of time-of-use (TOU) pricing and managed charging on EV charging behavior. We find that while TOU pricing is effective at shifting EV charging into off-peak hours, it unintentionally induces new and larger “shadow peaks” of simultaneous charging. These shadow peaks lead to greater exceedance of local capacity constraints and advance the need for distribution network upgrades. In contrast, centrally managed charging solves the coordination problem, reducing transformer capacity requirements, and is well tolerated by consumers in our setting. (JEL C93, D91, L62, L94, Q42)
articles.abstract_cn: 电动汽车的增长给电力系统带来了新的挑战。我们实施了一项实地实验，以评估分时定价和受控充电对电动汽车充电行为的影响。我们发现，虽然分时定价能有效将电动汽车充电转移到非高峰时段，但它无意中引发了新的、更大的同时充电“影子高峰”。这些影子高峰导致对当地容量约束的超出更加严重，并提前了配电网络升级的需求。相比之下，集中管理的充电解决了协调问题，降低了变压器容量需求，并且在我们的环境中得到了消费者的良好接受。(JEL C93, D91, L62, L94, Q42)
